title: Halt memo on Rendlesham lights

tellings.quote: Lieutenant Colonel Charles halt detailed the entire incident in a memo to the UK Ministry of Defense he said that a security patrol saw strange lights descending into the nearby rendlesham Forest

plain: In 1980, a security patrol near a US air base in England is said to have seen strange lights coming down into the nearby Rendlesham Forest. Michels says an Air Force officer there, Lieutenant Colonel Charles Halt, set out the whole incident in a memo to the UK Ministry of Defence, the British government department in charge of the military. He brings it up as an official, signed account of something unexplained seen near a military base.
